usage.summary:
Implemented ownership checking with a fixed `/bin/sh` exec launcher, updated observers and docs, and added regression coverage. Local acceptance passed.

Docker acceptance is blocked by the immutable [fixture policy](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plumbing-build-472475758/internal/plumbing/docker_go_runtime_591_accept_test.go:642): it rejects Go’s literal `-v` as a Docker volume flag while also requiring that argument during compilation. Correcting this requires an out-of-scope test change; I left it unchanged.

The new decision and unavailable real-Docker checks remain merger work.
